entries.zh: 出神：投身于默观而神魂超拔、浑然忘我
entries.en: to be rapt in contemplation; to fall into ecstasy, to be lost in a trance
to throw, hurl, fling

entries.zh: 掷入水中，把（人、物）扔进水里
entries.en: to throw (someone or something) into the water

entries.zh: 把东西掷到船上，掷过船去
entries.en: to throw something over to the ship, to fling (it) aboard
entries.notes: L 栏 "ut fracto. q." 为拉丁文残文，费解；义据 H"掷过舡"与 "al naúio" 定为掷向/掷过船。

entries.zh: 掷去，抛掉（"去"作趋向补语，承前"掷"字）
entries.en: to fling away, to throw off
entries.notes: H 仅存"去"、M 括注 (cag) 承前"掷"，故按"掷去"读；R 栏音 "chun Tǐn" 与"去"不合，待考。

entries.en: to throw, toss (so as to strike or hit)
entries.notes: H 作"戏"[疑:献]，当为闽南 hìⁿ"扔"之记音；L "hirando" 疑即 hiriendo（击中）。

entries.zh: 抛掷，扔（"戏却掷"三字连用同义，加重语气）
entries.en: to throw, toss (synonymic compound)
entries.notes: H 三字连书，M/R 音写未能一一对应，词形待考。

entries.en: to throw, fling
entries.notes: H 掸[疑:挨]；M tã、R Tān 与闽南 tàn"扔"合，取记音。

entries.en: to throw a stone, to hurl a stone (at something)
entries.notes: H 首字[疑]；义据"石头"与 L "piedra" 定。

entries.zh: 抛、甩（原注谓用某种器具投掷，器具名未详）
entries.en: to throw, fling (with an instrument whose name is unclear)
entries.notes: L "guastéquere" 与 "Hoy hin guiṽl. d—" 残损难解，唯"抛掷"一义可定。

entries.zh: 甩，用力抛出（"却丢"连用同义）
entries.en: to fling, to hurl away
entries.notes: L "depechando" 即 despechando（用力甩掷），与 M "guiō hū" 相合。

entries.en: to fling, to cast
entries.notes: L "depechar" 同 despechar，指挥臂用力掷出。

entries.en: to dash down, to hurl down (so as to break)
entries.notes: H 摔[疑:捌]；M "siag" 即 siak，闽南"摔掷"义。

entries.en: to smash, to break by throwing down
entries.notes: H 摔破[疑:捌破]；义据 M "siag pòa" 与 L "quebrando" 定。

entries.en: to throw away, to cast out, to discard
to throw away, to discard (what one flings from the hand)

entries.zh: 抛掉，甩掷（"丢却掷"连用同义）
entries.en: to fling away, to cast off, to reject
to throw (stones) here and there, to toss about
entries.notes: L 栏 "una y otra pe—" 截断，原词当作 piedra（石头）。

entries.en: 〔text lost; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H、M、R 三栏皆空，仅存西语词头，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 向某人扔东西（"丢坬"字形与音读均未详）
entries.en: to throw something toward someone
entries.notes: H 坬[疑:墘/堸]，R 栏带 T99 污损，quē/cauay 所指未详。

entries.zh: 投石，掷石（"射"为掷石义的记音借字）
entries.en: to throw a stone, to cast a stone, to stone
entries.notes: M "chiō" 带入声号，与"射"字常读不合，当作"石/掷"之记音。

entries.en: to hit the mark with a throw
entries.notes: H 仅存"着"，据 M "chiō tio"（射着）补足词形。

entries.en: to throw a stone and hit the mark
entries.notes: M 栏 cheu 带 T99 污损，H"射出头"与 L "pegar el clavo"（中的）不完全对应。

entries.en: to throw, to cast
entries.notes: L 栏 "arrojar sel ba aquellos recua rectia" 后半漫漶，义仅据 H/M 定为抛掷。

entries.en: to toss up, to throw upward
entries.notes: H 摽[疑:标]，R 栏末音 T99 污损；义据"上去"及 L "hacia arriba" 定。
